body:
ALIGNMENT AUDIT GAP: candidate nomination affects which states can receive posterior mass, but the published HsmmResult proves only the deduplicated anchor set and discards how those anchors were nominated. hsmm.scala states this residual explicitly. candidates.scala claims each Nomination carries a receipt, yet its channel, feature space, and receipt are raw strings; the semantic generator currently writes receipt = level:<n>, which is a hierarchy label rather than a provider call or derivation receipt, and lexical nominations carry none.

CONSEQUENCE. Two runs with the same anchor set but different nominating channels, provider/geometry identities, raw rankings, or receipts can publish equal HsmmResult values and identical wire artifacts. The posterior math may be identical, but the scientific route that made those states available is not. This prevents exact audit, reproducible candidate-generation ablations, and honest visualization of why an anchor was considered. It is the documented residual becoming product-critical, not evidence that current P or F arithmetic is wrong.

REQUIRED DESIGN BEFORE CODE. Name the separate coordinates rather than laundering all strings into one wrapper: typed channel kind; channel-local nonnegative rank; finite raw score with declared direction/meaning and never probability semantics; feature-space/provider/geometry identities where applicable; hierarchy stratum separately from an execution/derivation receipt; and an explicit deterministic lexical derivation identity. Decide which relations make a nomination non-Cartesian and close apply/copy/fromProduct/Mirror doors if needed. Candidate-set construction must validate canonicality and derive a complete nomination fingerprint. HsmmResult validation and AlignWire/codec must carry and verify that fingerprint or checked nomination packet against the exact recall units, source view, and candidate anchors. A caller-selected label cannot establish provenance.

COURTS. Same anchors plus different lawful nomination provenance must remain distinguishable in the published audit identity while producing unchanged P/F when all numeric inputs are otherwise fixed. A changed rank/space/provider/geometry/receipt without a recomputed packet must refuse. Negative rank, NaN/infinite score, space/channel mismatch, hierarchy label posing as a receipt, and foreign recall/source identity must refuse. Lexical-only, semantic-only, fused, and complete-abstention controls must construct. Ablation must remove a typed channel without turning provider failure into participant intrusion. Wire round-trip and drift courts are required. Each refusal names the mutation it kills.

SCOPE RULE. This crosses align plus codec and is not safely sliceable as a half-carried provenance field. Before assignment, the author must post exact paths, migration/version impact, reviewer, reference-scope gate, and whether ADR 0001/0002 needs a line. No code is authorized by this bead alone.
